mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) combined with perphenazine (antipsychotic) increases risk of severe hypertension, hyperthermia, and CNS toxicity through monoamine potentiation and additive anticholinergic/sympathomimetic effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if combination necessary, use lowest doses with careful blood pressure monitoring, patient education on hypertensive crisis symptoms, and consideration of alternative antipsychotic with lower interaction risk.
